name: Nehemiah G. Ordway
bio: Nehemiah G. Ordway was governor of Dakota Territory, and the Cow Boy credited him in May 1884 with organizing Billings County, probably one of his last official acts before his term expired that summer. In July 1884 the paper criticized him for believing Gallien's stories about cowboys.
